title: 4521-MOM-LOI-039-062-0001-GAR Performnace Test Procedure
summary:
- Document describes performance testing procedure for Oil to Salt heat exchangers.
- Tests aim to determine thermal balance, pressure drop, HAT/CAT values, and OHTC/Duty/Pressure loss.
- Calculation method based on ASME PTC 12.5, comparing test data with predicted values.
- Stakeholders must agree on testing procedures, reference conditions, and fouling conditions.
- Testing responsible by client; LOINTEK provides qualified personnel for validation.
